title: 'Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lily Part 2' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs
content:
The official website of the Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ) original television anime revealed an additional pair of cast, theme songs, and the main visual (pictured) for its second part on Thursday.

The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.30 p.m. Tokyo MX, followed by broadcasts on ABC TV, TV Aichi, BS Nippon Television, and AT-X.

Voice actors Yuusuke Shirai ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) and Yuuko Natsuyoshi ( Hanazakari no Kimitachi e ) are joining the cast as Mutchi and Shiromofu, respectively.

South Korean girl group ILLIT ( Himesama "Goumon" no Jikan desu 2nd Season ) is performing the opening theme "Swingin' Magic," while idol unit Lulutto Lily is performing the ending theme song "Dream à la Mode."

Shintarou Douge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director) is returning to helm the anime at Studio Pierrot . Yuuko Kakihara ( Hataraku Saibou ) is handling the series composition and script. Hirono Nishiki ( Shiunji-ke no Kodomotachi animation director), Mami Sodeyama ( Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai ), and Namiko Torii ( Totsukuni no Shoujo (2022) animation director) are designing the characters. ha-j is composing the music.

The Pierrot Magical Girl Series spanned from 1983 to 1988 and includes five classic titles: Mahou no Tenshi Creamy Mami ( Magical Angel Creamy Mami ) (1983–1984), Mahou no Yousei Persia ( Persia the Magic Fairy ) (1984–1985), Mahou no Star Magical Emi ( Star Magician Magical Emi ) (1985–1986), Mahou no Idol Pastel Yumi ( Magical Idol Pastel Yumi ) (1986), and Mahou no Stage Fancy Lala ( Magical Stage Fancy Lala ) (1998).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Nao Maita Launches New Manga on December 28
content:
The October issue of Shogakukan 's Ciao magazine revealed on Thursday that manga creator Nao Maita will launch a new manga in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 28. The announcement did not reveal the manga's title or other details.

The same issue published the final chapter of Maita's Shining! manga (seen right). Maita launched the series in Ciao magazine in July 2023. Shogakukan shipped the manga's ninth compiled book volume on July 24. The manga's 10th volume will be the final volume and it will ship on December 25.

Maita launched the Otona wa Wakattekurenai. manga in Ciao in December 2019, and ended it with the eighth volume in April 2023.

Maita launched the Age 12 ( 12-Sai. ) manga in 2012, and ended the series in October 2019. The manga received a 20th volume that includes new stories set after the characters graduate from elementary school and move on to junior high. The manga won Best Children's Manga at the 64th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2019.

Age 12 inspired the 12-Sai: Chiccha na Mune no Tokimeki ( Age 12 : A Little Heart-Pounding) television anime in 2016, two original video anime series, and a live-action DVD special.

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film Opens at #1, Chiikawa Film Drops to #2
content:
Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, ranked at #1 in its opening weekend. The film sold 535,000 tickets and and earned 939,647,100 yen (about US$5.95 million) in its first three days.

The film got IMAX screenings in Japan on Friday, the same day it opened in theaters.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

Yuki Kajiura 's solo project FictionJunction performs the theme song "Kanata."

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, dropped from #1 to #2 in its sixth weekend. The film sold 369,000 tickets and earned 547,161,400 yen (about US$3.46 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 8.49 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 12,228,816,100 yen (about US$77.51 million).

The film is getting 4DX screenings beginning on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film will take place on September 11 and penlight screenings will take place on September 23.

The film opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

The film's story begins with Chiik awa and Hachiware relaxing, when a rabbit with a flyer on its face suddenly appears. Hachiware looks at the flyer, which reads, "Invitation to a special island." Lured by tempting promises including great rewards for simple hunts on the island and essentially free sweet and spicy dishes such as limited-edition island ramen and sweets, Chiik awa and friends decide to go to the island. Suspicious with the flyer, Rakko goes with them to the island. What awaits them when they arrive on the island?

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, stayed at #5 in its fifth weekend. The film earned 133,316,300 yen (about US$845,000) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,528,229,550 yen (about US$16.02 million).

The film ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 441,000 tickets and earned 539,371,500 yen (about US$3.41 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in Japan on July 31.

The film centers on "the land of yōkai." The Nohara family go to Hiroshi's hometown of Akita to attend a famous fireworks festival during the summer. However, an incident causes yōkai to escape from their land and will wreak havoc in Akita, and in other areas throughout Japan. The Nohara family then go to the land of yōkai, and find themselves in a mysterious yet nostalgic world, where they go on an unpredictable adventure.

Sairi Itō stars in the film as Yako, a nine-tailed fox yōkai. Sakamoto of the comedy duo Mayurika plays the Squid Yōkai, first base player of the Edomae Sushies baseball team, which challenged Shi n-chan and his friends to a baseball game.

Other cast members include Yumiko Kobayashi , Miki Narahashi , Toshiyuki Morikawa , and Satomi Koorogi .

Masaki Watanabe ( Battle Spirits: Heroes , Sakamoto Days ) directed the film. Yoshiko Nakamura ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- franchise , PriPara ) penned the script. Shinei Animation , TV Asahi , ADK Emotions , and Futabasha produced the film, and TOHO is distributing. Singer TOMOO performs the film's theme song "Otona ni Nattara" (When I Become an Adult).

Kingdom : Tamashii no Kessen (Decisive Battle of the Soul), the fifth live-action film based on Yasuhisa Hara 's Kingdom manga, stayed at #7 in its seventh weekend. The film earned 134,544,300 yen (about US$852,800) over the weekend, and has earned a cumulative total of 6,391,349,700 yen (about US$40.51 million).

The film sold 993,000 tickets and earned 1,584,148,300 yen (about US$9.67 million) in its first three days. Counting the Marine Day holiday on July 20, the film sold 1,315,000 tickets and earned 2.064 billion yen (about US$12.59 million) in its first four days.

The new film opened in Japan on July 17.

Yasuhisa Hara 's historical manga centers around the slave boy Xin and his dream of becoming a great general for the state of Qin. Xin helps Ying Zheng, the young Qin king who shares his desire to unify China, rise to power within the state. Xin does all he can to become a superior commander of an army capable of defeating the Seven Warring States.

Shinsuke Satō (live-action Gantz , Death Note Light up the NEW world , Bleach ) returned to direct. Tsutomu Kuroiwa ( Black Butler , Golden Kamuy ) wrote the screenplay with Hara. Yutaka Yamada ( Bleach , Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- ) composed the music.

The live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga left the top 10 in its fourth weekend.

title: Crunchyroll Adds Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta Anime Special's English Dub
content:
Crunchyroll began streaming on Wednesday an English dub for The Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta special . The listing does not note the cast or staff for the dub .

The 17-minute short debuted during a livestreamed event for the franchise in June 2021. Crunchyroll added the short to its library in the same month.

Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the anime's second season , debuted on the AT-X channel on July 8 and also runs on Tokyo MX , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , BS11 , and TV Aichi .

Like the first season, the second season inspired a "Yōjo Shenki 2" (The Shaga [sic] of Tanya the Evil 2) mini-anime. Each mini anime episode runs immediately after each Saga of Tanya the Evil II episode on AT-X , and then streams on the Kadokawa Anime Channel on YouTube starting that Thursday at midnight JST for two weeks. The new mini anime also features the new members of the Salamander Kampfgruppe.

The second season was announced in June 2021.

The television anime adaptation of the novels premiered in January 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation streamed an English dub .

The anime also had a film that opened in Japan in February 2019, with a returning staff and cast. Crunchyroll screened the film in the United States in May 2019, and began streaming it in September 2019.

Yen Press licensed both the original Saga of Tanya the Evil light novel series and Chika Tōjō 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

High above the blood- and mud-soaked trenches, a young girl pits herself against army mages in high stakes aerial duels with bullets, spells, and bayonets. Her name is Tanya Degurechaff and she is the Devil of the Rhine, one of the greatest soldiers the Empire has ever seen! But inside her mind lives a ruthless, calculating ex-salaryman who enjoyed a peaceful life in Japan until he woke up in a war-torn world. Reborn as a destitute orphaned girl with nothing to her name but memories of a previous life, Tanya will do whatever it takes to survive, even if she can find it only behind the barrel of a gun!

Carlo Zen and Shinobu Shinotsuki launched the novel series in 2013, and Kadokawa published the 14th volume in September 2023. Tōjo launched the manga in Monthly Comp Ace in 2016, Kadokawa published the 35th volume on August 25.
author: ANN

title: TV Anime 'Kin to Tetsu' Announces Lead Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayaka Katayama 's Kin to Tetsu ( Fungus and Iron ) manga revealed the lead staff and a second teaser visual (pictured) on Tuesday.

Keitarou Motonaga ( Hametsu no Oukoku , Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru? ) is directing the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab .

Katayama began drawing the dystopian sci-fi suspense manga in Bessatsu Shounen Magazine in March 2021 and will end it in the October issue on September 9. Kodansha published the ninth volume on April 9, with the tenth and final volume set to be released on October 8.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga for digital release in English in January 2022 and published the eighth e-book volume on February 24.

Katayama made her debut in 2007 after her one-shot Oni Oi no Kawa was selected for the 78th Shounen Magazine Newcomer Manga Awards. The following year, she won the Grand Prize at Shueisha's inaugural Golden Tiara Award for her sci-fi romcom manga Star Man .

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Reveals More Cast, Returning Theme Song Artists, October 4 Debut for 2nd Part
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Thursday the main visual, additional cast members, theme song artists, and October 4 debut for the second cours (quarter of a year) of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot .

Newly announced cast members are:

Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, a resident of the magical land Felix Star and also the head of the executive committee of the "Magic Festival"

Yūko Natsuyoshi as Shiromofu, a furball-like creature that also lives in Felix Star

K-pop girl group ILLIT returns from the anime's first part to perform the new opening theme song "Swingin' Magic." The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) also return to perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."

The anime's second part will debut on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 10:30 p.m. JST, and will also run on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X .

The anime's story centers on sisters Fū and Rui, who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fū encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fū and Rui become active as idols.

The anime stars:

• May Tachibana as Fū Nonoyama/Lilly Konpeto (idol form)

• Nao Ojika as Rui Nonoyama/Lulu Mashū (idol form)

• Hiroki Nanami as Uguisu

• Ai Kayano as Azuki

• Fūka Izumi as Tōko Kandachi

• Fū Hirohara as Sena Aozono

• Hikaru Yaotome as Miitaa

• Kōhei Amasaki as Shōta Seo

• Tatsumaru Tachibana as Hisashi Kadoya

• Tomokazu Sugita as Yasuo Kandachi

• Jun Kasama as Keiichi Nonoyama

• Megumi Ōhara as Shio Nonoyama

• Aya Endō as Matsuri Hinoura

Takako Ohta and Yū Mizushima , who voiced Yū Morisawa / Creamy Mami and Toshio Ohtomo respectively in the Magical Angel Creamy Mami anime franchise , also appear in the anime as guest cast members.

The anime previously announced that Miyari Nemoto will join the anime's second part as Asahi Araki, an idol otaku and a huge fan of Lily, who auditioned to be an idol and joins Production Once More.

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 12th episode posted on June 27, and now has subtitles in 26 languages.
author: ANN

Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, a resident of the magical land Felix Star and also the head of the executive committee of the "Magic Festival"

The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) also return to perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."
The anime's second part will debut on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 10:30 p.m. JST, and will also run on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X .

contentBlocks.text: The anime's story centers on sisters Fū and Rui, who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fū encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fū and Rui become active as idols.
The anime stars:
May Tachibana as Fū Nonoyama/Lilly Konpeto (idol form)
Nao Ojika as Rui Nonoyama/Lulu Mashū (idol form)
Hiroki Nanami as Uguisu
Ai Kayano as Azuki
Fūka Izumi as Tōko Kandachi
Fū Hirohara as Sena Aozono
Hikaru Yaotome as Miitaa
Kōhei Amasaki as Shōta Seo
Tatsumaru Tachibana as Hisashi Kadoya
Tomokazu Sugita as Yasuo Kandachi
Jun Kasama as Keiichi Nonoyama
Megumi Ōhara as Shio Nonoyama
Aya Endō as Matsuri Hinoura
Takako Ohta and Yū Mizushima , who voiced Yū Morisawa / Creamy Mami and Toshio Ohtomo respectively in the Magical Angel Creamy Mami anime franchise , also appear in the anime as guest cast members.
The anime previously announced that Miyari Nemoto will join the anime's second part as Asahi Araki, an idol otaku and a huge fan of Lily, who auditioned to be an idol and joins Production Once More.

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 12th episode posted on June 27, and now has subtitles in 26 languages.

title: Concept Art Awards to Honor Yoshitaka Amano for Lifetime Achievement
content:
Amano is most well known for his contributions to Vampire Hunter D and the Final Fantasy series, as well as his collaboration with English graphic novelist Neil Gaiman on Sandman: The Dream Hunters . He has been in the anime industry since he was 15, when he joined the veteran studio Tatsunoko Production , and has contributed to many anime and video game projects.

GIBIATE PROJECT , a global IP development group that includes Amano, developed the Gibiate series. The group announced the anime at Anime Expo 2019. The anime premiered in July 2020. Amano also drew the character designs for the Exception Netflix anime, which debuted in October 2022.

ZAN is an upcoming anime project based on his DEVA ZAN art. Amano announced on June 17 that he had established the Los Angeles-based company Yoshitaka Amano Inc., which revealed that production has begun on the anime. The project is now listed as a limited anime series.

title: Live-Action Bless Series Reveals New Video, Visuals
content:
Amazon Prime Video posted a new video for the live-action series of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga on Thursday. Amazon Prime Video also unveiled two visuals for the series.

Amazon Prime Video will stream the series worldwide exclusively in spring 2027.

Naniwa Danshi idol group member Ryūsei Ōnishi is starring in the project as Aia, and Ōnishi prepared before production started by visting Shiseido 's real-life makeup academy SABFA.

Izuru Kumasaka (2018's Tramps Like Us ) and Maki Tomita are directing the project, and Satoko Okazaki (live-action My Dress-Up Darling , episodes of Laughing Under the Clouds , Tiger & Bunny , live-action Waiting for Spring ) and Ichirō Kusuno ( Sushi Police , live-action Tokyo Ghoul ) are writing the scripts. Shiseido Beauty Creation Center is overseeing the makeup in the production. Amazon MGM Studios is presenting the project, and C & I Entertainment is producing.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English and it describes the story:

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

Sonomaya debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge magazine in 2022, and the series now runs in Monthly Shonen Sirius . Kodansha will publish the ninth volume on October 8. The manga has more than 1.25 million copies in circulation.

Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga's seventh volume on February 10. Kodansha is also releasing the manga digitally on its K MANGA service.

A-1 Pictures announced in March that it is producing a 2027 television anime adaptation of the manga.

title: Toworu Miyata's Aoharu Once More BL Manga Gets Light Anime
content:
IMAGICA Infos ' new boys-love label BALLOON announced on Thursday that it is producing a light anime adaptation of Toworu Miyata 's Aoharu Once More boys' love manga.

Rikako Machida ( Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace series composition) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio . Morrigan (WAVE) is composing the music. Kazuya Takahashi is credited for production supervision.

Tokyopop licensed the manga and will release it in English. Tokyopop describes the manga:

Hayato Kobayashi dreams of his high school days, of the soft wind blowing by and the light streaming in through the window onto the beautiful Ritsu Onishi, and of his dazzling smile.

ShuCream released the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2025.

Animate International is releasing Miyata's Living With Him , Delivery Hug Therapy , and 100dB Pouring into You manga in English. Living With Him inspired a live-action series adaptation in April 2024.

Aoharu Once More is the third project in the new boys-love label BALLOON , which launched with Dai Nippon Printing (DNP), CYBIRD , and BLUE RIGHTS last year.

The first project was the light anime adaptation of Tenma Asahi 's Saioshi no Gikei o Mederu Tame, Nagaikishimasu! (In Order to Love My Most Beloved Brother-In-Law, I'll Live a Long Life!) light novel series. The light anime premiered on January 3. OceanVeil began streaming the anime under the title I’ll Live a Long Life to Dote on My Favorite Stepbrother! on January 6.

The second project is the light anime adaptation of Kaoruko Miyama 's Perfect Addiction boys-love manga, which debuted on July 8. OceanVeil streamed the anime.

DNP spearheaded the concept of "light anime" to create animation at a lower cost on a more "timely" schedule compared to the traditional animation production workflow. The BALLOON label aims to produce four new titles in the 2026 fiscal year, with a goal of establishing a workflow capable of producing 10 or more projects a year by 2028.

title: Live-Action The Silent Service Reveals New Series' Title, Summer 2027 Debut in Teaser Video
content:
Amazon Prime Video Japan started streaming on Thursday a teaser trailer for the new sequel series of the live-action project of Kaiji Kawaguchi 's The Silent Service manga, and revealed the title Chinmoku no Kantai Mezame yo, New York ( The Silent Service : Awaken, New York). The teaser also revealed the new series' summer 2027 worldwide debut exclusively on Prime Video, and returning cast members from the previous film and series.

The returning cast members for the new sequel are:

• Takao Ōsawa as Shiro Kaieda

• Hiroshi Tamaki as Hiroshi Fukamachi

• Aya Ueto as Ichiya Hiromi

• Aoi Nakamura as Eiji Yamanaka

• Yūsuke Santamaria as Eiichi Nanba

• Kenjirō Tsuda as Jun Ōtaki

• Yui Natsukawa as Hitomi Sonezaki

• Takashi Sasano as Toshio Takegami

• Yōsuke Eguchi as Wataru Unabara

The teaser also reveals that the story is heading to its climax. Takao Ōsawa , producer who also plays protagonist Shiro Kaieda, stated in the sequel announcement in March that the staff is committed to adapting the full story to its conclusion.

Chinmoku no Kantai Hokkyoku-kai dai kaisen ( The Silent Service : The Battle of the Arctic Ocean), the sequel film for the live-action project of Kaiji Kawaguchi 's The Silent Service manga, opened in Japan in September 2025. Kōhei Yoshino directed the film, with a script by Hikaru Takai . The film began exclusively streaming globally on Amazon Prime Video on March 20. The stream is a special edition, which includes previously unreleased scenes featuring Hiroshi Tamaki as Hiroshi Fukamachi, the captain of the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force submarine Tatsunami. The Amazon Prime stream edition also includes previously unreleased scenes featuring Jun Ōtaki (portrayed by Kenjirō Tsuda ) and Wataru Unabara (portrayed by Yōsuke Eguchi ).

The first film opened in Japan on September 29, 2023, and sold 274,000 tickets for 370,136,800 yen (about US$2.46 million at the time) in its first three days. Takao Ōsawa and Shinzō Matsuhashi produced the live-action film, Kōhei Yoshino directed the film, and Hikaru Takai wrote the script. B'z, with singer Ado as vocalist, contributed the film's theme song "Dignity."

In the story, Shiro Kaieda is appointed the captain of Japan's first nuclear submarine, jointly built by Japan and the United States in top secret. However, he and his 76 crew members go rogue in this story that delves into themes of nuclear war, international politics, and world peace.

The live-action series sequel titled Chinmoku no Kantai Season 1: Tokyowan Daikaisen ( Silent Service Season 1: The Battle of Tokyo Bay) premiered on Amazon Prime in February 2024. The series' first four episodes focus on unreleased scenes not depicted in the film. Episodes 5-8 tell a sequel story.

Kawaguchi ( Eagle , Kūbo Ibuki ) serialized the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine from 1988 to 1996. The manga already inspired a television anime special from Sunrise in 1996, followed by Sunrise 's two-part original video anime from 1997 to 1998. Central Park Media offered the anime on videotape and later DVD.
